release_notes: `_CAPITAL_MARGIN_TTL` was 30s, shorter than the 60s `loadTradeStatuses` dashboard poll that's the only thing reading it — the cache could never survive to the next poll, so every tick made a fresh `basket_margin()` call to the broker. Landing next to `trade_ltp()`'s own call on the same tick, this contributed to steady ~1/min Dhan 429s traced on a live real position. Bumped to 65s so the cache actually hits.
